description: Who bought and who sold a token in the last hours: buy and sell count and USD volume, net flow, buy/sell ratio, the top buyer and seller wallets with net USD, and the largest trades, read from the swap events of its biggest DEX pools (Uniswap v2/v3 style, Aerodrome, Velodrome, PancakeSwap, Trader Joe and more) on Base, Ethereum, BSC, Arbitrum, Polygon, Avalanche or Optimism. Flags one-sided selling and a single wallet dumping. For trading agents before or after a buy. Window 1 to 24 hours. Price: $0.006 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"token":"0x532f27101965dd16442E59d40670FaF5eBB142E4","chain":"base","hours":2}.

chain.description: base, ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, polygon, avalanche or optimism. Default base
